description: You are an IT manager responsible for benchmarking your organization's self-hosted Jitsi Meet deployment. Using Jitsi Meet at http://localhost:8080, join the meeting room named 'QualityTestRoom'. Once inside the active meeting, perform the following diagnostic steps: (1) Open the connection statistics panel to review real-time network performance metrics for the current session. (2) Navigate to the video quality settings and change the video quality to the highest available option. (3) Switch the participant display mode to tile/grid view. (4) Navigate to the speaker statistics feature to view speaking-time data. Compile your findings into a diagnostic report at /home/ga/Desktop/meeting_quality_report.txt. The report must include: the meeting room URL, the network performance metrics you observed (such as packet loss, latency, jitter, or bitrate), the video quality option you selected, and observations about the tile view and speaker statistics. This report will be submitted to the IT infrastructure team to evaluate whether Jitsi Meet meets organizational SLAs.
